author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam McWilliams signs minor league deal with Boston
desc: The Red Sox signed RHP Sam McWilliams to a minor league contract.
impact: McWilliams will add more pitching depth in the Red Sox organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Suarez activated from paternity list
desc: The Athletics activated LHP José Suarez from the paternity list.
impact: Suarez returns to the Athletics after being away for a few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Krook designated for assignment
desc: The Athletics designated LHP Matt Krook for assignment.
impact: Krook loses his spot on the Athletics 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Santiago Espinal signs minor league deal with Rangers
desc: The Rangers signed INF Santiago Espinal to a minor league contract.
impact: Espinal was previously in the Dodgers organization. He'll add infield depth for Texas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Lagrange (shoulder) placed on Triple-A IL
desc: Yankees prospect Carlos Lagrange was placed on the injured list at Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre with a right shoulder injury.
impact: Lagrange is scheduled to undergo an MRI. There should be an update on a potential timetable by the end of this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alan Rangel optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Phillies optioned RHP Alan Rangel to Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Rangel threw four scoreless frames on Thursday against the Pirates. He could get another opportunity with the Phillies later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Wicks optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Cubs optioned LHP Jordan Wicks to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Wicks will remain stretched out as a starter in Triple-A. He could get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miguel Ullola optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned RHP Miguel Ullola to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Ullola made his MLB debut against the Twins on Monday when he threw two scoreless innings. He could get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Hernandez sent outright by Dodgers
desc: The Dodgers sent RHP Jonathan Hernandez outright to Triple-A Oklahoma City.
impact: Hernandez was designated for assignment on Tuesday and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Dodgers organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Diaz (elbow) throws successful bullpen Thursday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters on Thursday that right-hander Edwin Díaz threw 28 pitches during a successful bullpen session.
impact: Diaz could face live hitters this weekend. He remains on track to be activated later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Esmerlyn Valdez drives in three runs Thursday
desc: Esmerlyn Valdez went 2-for-4 with three RBI in the Pirates 6-1 win over the Phillies on Thursday.
impact: Valdez hit an RBI single, triple and collected a sacrifice fly. He is now hitting .316 on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Jones pitches four innings Thursday
desc: Jared Jones allowed one run on two hits over four innings with six strikeouts and two walks in a no-decision on Thursday against the Phillies.
impact: Jones was removed after just 73 pitches through four innings. He'll be tough to trust in his next start against the Braves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Merrill goes deep Thursday
desc: Jackson Merrill went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Padres 12-7 loss against the Dodgers on Wednesday.
impact: Merrill went yard as part of a four-run second inning for San Diego. He is still hitting just .212 on the season with nine home runs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Cronenworth hits home run Thursday
desc: Jake Cronenworth went 1-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Padres 12-7 loss against the Dodgers on Thursday.
impact: Cronenworth put the Padres ahead 6-0 in the top of the second inning with a three-run blast. They would go on to be out-scored 12-1 the rest of the night.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez takes no-decision Thursday
desc: Randy Vasquez allowed four runs on seven hits over three innings with one walk in a no-decision on Thursday against the Dodgers.
impact: The Padres gave Vasquez an early 6-0 lead, but he gave up six runs right back before it got worse for the bullpen. His struggles to end June continued into July.
